title: Interaction Event is the native rich-evidence sink
summary: Interaction Event v0.3 carries native information-use, generation-intent and derived-finding objects. Compatibility tags may assist routing, but downstream evidence authority belongs to the constrained native objects.
invariants: Events are append-only/sealed rich evidence records.
Assessments can disagree and are never rewritten into facts.
UNKNOWN privacy fails closed in deidentified projection.
Native evidence is constrained to opaque/token/scalar fields so prose cannot hide in supposedly safe evidence channels.
Customer-bearing source references may disappear while privacy/use/intent/finding residue survives.

provenance.claim: Native structured evidence objects, constrained evidence fields, privacy-safe residue and tag authority boundary.
Append-only capture, assessment disagreement, privacy and causal boundary invariants.
